_comment: Gene sets used for immune-context scoring. 'source' records where the gene list comes from; sets marked 'curated marker panel' are assembled here from canonical lineage markers rather than copied from a single publication, and are labelled as such in the write-up.

CYT.source: Rooney et al., Cell 2015 - cytolytic activity

IFNG_6.source: Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017 - 6-gene preliminary IFN-gamma signature

TIS_18.source: Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017 - 18-gene T-cell-inflamed gene expression profile

IFNG_EXPANDED.source: Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017 - expanded immune signature

CD8_T_CELL.source: curated marker panel - CD8 T cell lineage

TLS_CABRITA.source: Cabrita et al., Nature 2020 - tertiary lymphoid structure signature

TREG.source: curated marker panel - regulatory T cells

M2_MACROPHAGE.source: curated marker panel - M2-like / tumour-associated macrophages

ANTIGEN_PRESENTATION.source: curated marker panel - MHC class I antigen processing and presentation

MHC_II.source: curated marker panel - MHC class II

CHECKPOINT.source: curated marker panel - inhibitory immune checkpoints

TYPE_I_IFN.source: curated marker panel - type I interferon response

TGFB_FTBRS.source: Mariathasan et al., Nature 2018 - pan-fibroblast TGF-beta response signature

PROLIFERATION.source: curated marker panel - cell cycle / proliferation

EPITHELIAL.source: curated marker panel - epithelial/tumour-cell content proxy (used for purity adjustment)

SQUAMOUS_MARKERS.source: curated marker panel - lung squamous / basal programme (histology classifier)

ADENO_MARKERS.source: curated marker panel - lung adenocarcinoma / alveolar programme (histology classifier)
